**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Prune deleted state branches when refreshing reservations**

When a previously fetched workflow state branch is deleted from origin, this fetch succeeds but leaves its remote-tracking ref intact, so `reservation_holders()` continues treating its abandoned reservations as live indefinitely. Using the added cross-workflow fixture, fetching once, deleting `spacedock-state/dev2` from origin, and checking ADR 0060 still produces R8 against the deleted branch without a stale-fetch warning. This blocks an otherwise available number and makes `reserve` unnecessarily skip it. Prune the explicitly fetched namespace on successful refresh; local `git fetch -h` describes `--prune` as “prune remote-tracking branches no longer on remote.”
